state.claim: You see the number today? 33.1 GDP. The biggest in the history of our country by almost triple, right? Almost triple. Now it’s very much bigger than any GDP we’ve ever had. You have to go back to the 1950s, and then it’s less than half. This is the greatest number, 33.1 percent.
state.query: What country and what specific GDP measure (annualized quarterly rate, year-over-year, nominal or real) does the 33.1 percent figure refer to, and for what time period was it reported?
